assessment.basis: Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.
qualifications: Every compared free coefficient lies inside its positive printed source error width. Target-branch agreement only, conditional on the existing coupled approximate-volume fit and Table 2 priors. Fixed LS K0-prime=4, and the Fp48 HS V0 anchor where applicable, are constraints, not independently recovered values. Prior regularization supports agreement and does not independently validate the endmembers or full spin-crossover fit. Reconstruction covariance remains unknown; this is a source-width central-value comparison, not combined-error or author-workflow parity. Earlier audit wording (superseded only for the named numerical scope): Coupled three-level spin-state reconstruction using the recovered earlier observations and Solomatova Table 2 priors. The original MINUTI input, row weights, residual definition, and covariance are unpublished, so this equal-weight approximate-volume fit tests numerical similarity rather than claiming an exact reproduction.

fit.objective: equal-weight approximate volume residuals plus Table 2 priors
fit.comparison_scope: Compared free coefficients: K0, K0_prime; scope=parameter_agreement

primary_source_check.finding: Table 7 supplies paired HS/LS BM3 reference branches from coupled MINUTI crossover fits; these are genuine composition/source-data branches but are not the mixed-spin mixer itself.

primary_data_check.finding: All 45 measured Fp48 P-V observations and the complete 36-row derived crossover grid are bundled. Outside the crossover, the respective branch reproduces the source values.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Solomatova (2016), Table 7 and MINUTI analysis: coupled HS/LS reference branches inferred from measured compression trajectories, including the cited experimental datasets. Model decomposition does not make these ab-initio fits.
parameter_provenance.equation: Table 7 and MINUTI discussion: third-order Birch-Murnaghan high-spin and low-spin reference branches in a coupled spin-crossover fit.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 7 HS column: 77.29 A^3 per conventional B1 cell.
parameter_provenance.original_dataset: Fp48 data measured in this study.
parameter_provenance.fit_relationship: The paired branches, transition pressure, and transition width form one source spin-crossover model; Peritheos currently stores only the independently executable reference branches.
